title: Finish harmonising container deposit schemes across states
action: Complete the 2021 ministerial agreement to align which containers are covered, refund amounts, labelling standards and community education across all schemes, and build the single national portal for container approvals so suppliers register once.
why: Eight different schemes make national beverage suppliers register, label and report separately in each state, adding cost that a common scheme design would avoid without weakening recycling.

evidence.source: Container deposit scheme expansion: Consultation summary report
evidence.publisher: WA Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
evidence.quote: In 2021, Australia's environment ministers agreed on harmonisation of CDS-eligible containers (size and products), refund amounts, standards for labelling and community education across jurisdictions by the end of 2025.

evidence.source: Container deposit scheme expansion: Consultation summary report
evidence.publisher: WA Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
evidence.quote: develop a single portal for container approvals across all jurisdictions to reduce the administrative burden for suppliers and improve harmonisation.
